system.description:
At 10th level, you learn to channel the wellspring of life and activity that meadows represent and harness that power. Choose one of the following:

Aerial Dance

When you use one of your Pollinator’s Dance features, a pair of wings that correspond to the pollinator you are calling upon sprouts from your back. You gain a fly speed equal to your Speed in addition to the benefits the specific dance grants. These wings persist for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier.

If you are still airborne when this feature ends, you are reduced to 0 hit points, or you are incapacitated, you fall at a rate of 30 feet per round.

Protective Pollen

You draw forth the pollen of wildflowers to debilitate your foes. When you are hit with a melee weapon attack, as a reaction you may conjure forth a cloud of pollen in a 15-foot cone originating from you. Creatures within the area of effect must succeed on a Constitution saving throw versus your spell save DC or become blinded until the start of your next turn. Creatures who fail their save by 5 or more also become incapacitated by coughing and sneezing. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again until you complete a short or a long rest.

Sudden Growth

You amplify springtime’s sudden burst of plants. As an action, you may touch the floor or slam a staff on the ground, causing a dense tangle of grasses and flowers to appear in a 30-foot radius centered on you. The effected area becomes difficult terrain, and creatures who first enter the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw versus your spell save DC or become slowed so long as they remain in the area of effect. The area persists so long as you can maintain concentration or until it is dispelled by magic such as dispel magic or similar spells. You are unaffected by the difficult terrain caused by this spell, but it does not move with you.You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
